headline: Preseason Week 1
text:
Chicago Bears
Bears 34, Browns 10
Top StorylineAfter sitting most starters, head coach Ben Johnson's squad rallied from an early 10-0 deficit with 34 unanswered points, showing off impressive roster depth and committing just two penalties all game.
Minnesota Vikings
Vikings 13, Giants 10
Top StorylineWith Kyler Murray taking over as the primary starter, all eyes were on how head coach Kevin O'Connell managed reps between Murray and young signal-caller J.J. McCarthy in their low-scoring road win at MetLife Stadium.
Detroit Lions
Bengals 16, Lions 14
Top StorylineDetroit focused on evaluating backup offensive line combinations and secondary depth, holding back primary starters while backup quarterbacks Rookie Luke Altmyer and recently signed veteran Josh Dobbs handled the snaps.
Green Bay Packers
Steelers 28, Packers 9
Top StorylineJordan Love sat out, leaving backup quarterbacks to struggle behind reserve offensive line units as Green Bay evaluated position battles in the defensive backfield and pass rush.

headline: Training Camps
text: We made it! By the end of the week, training camps will be up and operational for all NFC North teams.

camps.location: Halas Hall in Lake Forest, Illinois
camps.text: Defending NFC North Champs, the Bears enter camp focused on defensive consistency and Caleb Williams' year-three progression under head coach Ben Johnson.
Can the Lions rebuilt offensive line keep Jared Goff upright long enough for their explosive offense to finally make a deep playoff run?

camps.location: Ray Nitschke Field in Green Bay, Wisconsin
camps.text: After a five-game end-of-season collapse, the question is whether Jordan Love can recapture his elite 2023 form and lead a young roster past the NFC North's second-round ceiling.

camps.location: TCO Performance Center in Eagan, Minnesota
camps.text: With Kyler Murray arriving as the new starting quarterback, Minnesota is betting a regime change under center can unlock a roster talented enough to compete in the division's tightest race in years.

headline: Offseason Grades
text: The offseason grades are in and none of the NFC North teams did particularly well according to CBS Sports and PFT. C's across the board with the Packers getting a C- from CBS.
